findings.question: Q4
findings.title: Interrupted native retention leaves a live mapping pending; later recovery observes a replacement checkpoint and permits duplicate execution

related_lines.reason: Native retention is assigned only after it completes; failure leaves the raw mapping from line 977.
Recovery consumes whatever currently resides in the raw mapping.
A later pin recovers the pending handing before continuing.
Immediate recovery can fail at the same exhausted caller depth; second failure is swallowed while original failure propagates.

findings.evidence_kind: EXECUTED: deterministic fault injection plus native CPython stack-exhaustion corroboration without monkeypatches
smallest_reproduction: Use the existing synthetic battery fixture and _desk helper with BudgetReader.following(lambda: (o.ledgers, o.experiments)); retain a BudgetLedger.from_dict checkpoint before the first dispatch.
Dispatch the admitted simulate_pulse once; its executor records run.1 with BudgetLedger.settle.

Invoke reader.pinned() from a caller near the existing interpreter recursion limit. In probe_native_stack.py at depths 994/995 (limit 1000), accounts() returns the spent live dictionaries and native capture plus recovery encounter RecursionError. The pending buffer contains the original tuple of live dictionaries, with no unread spend barrier.
Outside the deep caller, replace o.ledgers[lid] with the pre-spend checkpoint using the normal object-replacement restore pattern.
Dispatch the same admitted action. Recovery now reads the replacement from the mutable dictionary, removes the pending obligation, and the executor runs again.
findings.actual_result: Native depth 994 and 995: pending_before_restore=[[4,"tuple"]], unread_before_restore={}, redispatch_refused=false, calls=2, sealed=null. Controlled two-interruption versions reproduce for KeyboardInterrupt, MemoryError and RecursionError.
findings.expected_result: A verification was handed the spend. An interrupted capture must not allow later recovery to treat the restored pre-spend account as that handed observation. The second dispatch must be refused, executor calls remaining 1; interruption alone must not falsely seal an unchanged honest reader.
findings.positive_controls: No interruption and one injected interruption both preserve the spend and refuse redispatch. Native neighboring depth 993 retains _RetainedHanding and refuses redispatch; depths 975..992 also refuse after restore. Existing R15 controls all pass (87 cases), so they miss the earlier native-retention transition.
findings.trust_boundary: Native corroboration changes no reader/account private state and installs no methods. It uses the execution owner's ordinary live dictionaries, public BudgetLedger.settle/from_dict, and the public gateway dispatch path. Private state is inspected only for diagnostics after failure. The injected cases model the interruption checkpoint, but the unpatched deep-caller case independently establishes the outcome. It is not the accepted spend-and-rollback-between-verifications residual: accounts() returned the spent mapping and the reader left a pending record for that handing.
findings.contract_reference: benchmarks/mind_gen2_authority_v1/README.md:311-315 says another interruption leaves the handing pending and preserves spend when a live dictionary entry is replaced after interruption; this path disproves that guarantee.
findings.regression_gap: test_interrupted_handing_preserves_spend_before_detached_restore injects _handed only after _retain_handing has succeeded. The generated handing phase uses the same later boundary. Neither exercises raw mapping -> native retained entries -> recovery failure.
findings.proposed_correction: Make the raw-mapping-to-retained-entry transition interruption-safe: never discharge an unfinished observation by rereading a live mapping that may have changed since the handing. Ensure the original native account entries survive before returning control, including at exhausted caller depth, or retain an unresolved observation that cannot grant currentness merely from later replacement contents. Preserve recovery for unchanged honest accounts and add the native-depth and two-interruption controls; no new budget authority is needed.
